description: List conversations and their live state, for keeping track of several at once. state: running (a turn is in progress) / idle (process alive, nothing running) / detached (no process; resumable). A running conversation also reports elapsed time, the tool it is executing and how much it has output this turn. Two sources are merged: conversations this server holds, and ones on DSH's disk that are not open (DSH's session/list leaves out open sessions). Pass only_running=true for just the active ones; follow up with dsh_read to see what one is producing.

include_closed.description: Whether to include conversations on disk that are not open (including ones created by other instances or the GUI). Default true. **Cost: it spawns a DSH process to probe the disk, about 1 second measured** (cached for 10 seconds). Pass false to list only what this server has open, in milliseconds.

only_running.description: Only return conversations with a turn in progress. Default false. **This mode skips the disk probe and answers in milliseconds** (a running conversation is always in memory).

name: dsh_list
title: List conversations
